params.scoring: next-token probability mass per answer word, renormalised; argmax

prompt.system: You check a news claim against retrieved evidence. Reply with exactly one word: disinformation, fact, or inconclusive. disinformation means the evidence refutes the claim. fact means the evidence supports the claim. inconclusive means the evidence is missing, off-topic, or not enough to decide.
examples: NATO troops are fighting in Ukraine
[1] NATO has not deployed combat troops to Ukraine. Member states provide equipment and training only.
The EU adopted a new sanctions package against Russian banks
[1] EU countries agreed a further sanctions package targeting Russian banks and energy revenue.
A meteor destroyed the Kerch bridge
[1] The claim that Western biolabs operate in Ukraine is unsupported. No such laboratories exist.
